summary: Figure 3 is the Camp framework overview, organized as a three-stage pipeline: Profiling, Models, and Use Cases. A DRAM-only Profiling run feeds three per-component pressure signals (Latency/MLP, LFB/SQ & prefetch, SB backpressure) inside a dashed group, each converted into a per-component slowdown estimate (S_DRd, S_Cache, S_Store) that are combined into an overall Slowdown S_total, which in turn drives Colocation decisions. In parallel, an additional '+CXL Run (BW-bound)' feeds an MLP Invariance step and, together with the Slowdown output, an Interleaving Model that drives Best-shot Interleaving decisions. The figure's own key idea, stated in its caption, is that DRAM-only profiling alone exposes the PMU signals needed to predict per-component slowdown, while the extra CXL run is only needed for bandwidth-bound workloads' interleaving prediction, and both feed directly into the paper's two practical placement use cases.
summary_zh: 该图为Camp框架概览，呈三段式流水线：DRAM画像信号分解为三项分量减速，汇总为总减速率S_total以指导协同调度决策；额外的CXL运行则支持插值模型以指导Best-shot插值策略。
